title: pvTemporalCache
body:
## pvTemporalCache

Keeps copies of the input at up to CacheSize recently requested time steps (ParaView default 2, range 2 to 10) and returns a cached copy when the same time is requested again, instead of re-running the upstream pipeline. Data and time values are unchanged. It helps when downstream temporal filters, e.g. pvTemporalInterpolator, repeatedly request the same steps from an expensive reader or filter chain.

Common mistakes and assumptions:

- Each cached step keeps a copy of the dataset in memory; keep CacheSize small for large meshes.
- Schemaxis generates this binding from ParaView's catalogue; it has not run a native acceptance check for this operation.

Native constructor: `TemporalCache`. Identity: `filters/TemporalCache`. Role: `pipeline`. Output kinds: `["data"]`.

### Inputs

| Port | Meaning / native port | Required | Multiplicity | Kind | Contract |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Input` | Required data input for the native Input port. Give the name of the upstream node to connect, or a {node, port} object to use another of its output ports. ParaView: This property specifies the input of the Temporal Cache filter. Accepted data: any data object (vtkDataObject). | True | one object | `data` | `{"compatibility":"native-domain-checked","composite":true,"cost":{"basis":"no benchmark","conversion":"none inserted","rating":"unknown"},"nativeTypes":["vtkDataObject"],"requirements":{},"traits":{"contiguity":"unknown","indexing":"unknown","iteration":"unknown"}}` |

### Options

| Key | Meaning / native assignment | Type and constraints | Default / required | Example value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `CacheSize` | The cache size determines the number of time steps that can be cached at one time. The maximum number is 10. The minimum is 2 (since it makes little sense to cache less than that). | `{"maximum":10,"minimum":2,"type":"integer"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `2` |

Execution contract:

```json
{
  "mode": "serial",
  "performance": "unknown"
}
```

Coverage and unbound native properties:

```json
{
  "defaults": "native defaults for omitted options",
  "gaps": {},
  "origin": "generated",
  "output": "native inspection required; explicit output-port selection available",
  "outputPorts": null,
  "qualification": "not-run"

```

### Syntax example

Place in `nodes`. Data outputs may be selected by a scene; resource outputs must be connected to a compatible consumer.

```json
{
  "id": "result",
  "filter": "pvTemporalCache",
  "inputs": {
    "Input": "UPSTREAM_Input"
  }
}
```
